In early January, the direct solar point is near the Tropic of Capricorn, and the solar declination is approximately 23.5°S. The latitude of the equator is 0°, noon solar altitude = 90° - |local latitude - latitude of direct solar point| = 90° - |0° - (-23.5°)| ≈ 66.5°. On the vertical line of 12 hours of day length, the point number close to an altitude of 66.5° is 2. Therefore the answer is 2.
